explanation30s: Cup Season is an app for a season-long golf league with your friends. Everyone posts their real rounds from wherever they play, and each round scores points against your own handicap — beat your number and you get more points, have a rough day and you still get five just for posting. Your best four rounds a month count and you owe at least two a month or you lose points. Points stack up over a 26-week season; there's a pot, a leaderboard, and side titles like Points King and Iron Man. Apparently the last four weeks are a 'Cup Final' that's scored fresh, but I only found that in the fine print — I honestly can't tell you how the winner is decided.

personaVerdict.question: I just finished a season — why would I start another?
personaVerdict.answer: To beat Galen — he's the only name the app made me care about — and only if more of the group is actually in it. The cup final is a line in the bylaws, the pot was never collected, and the app never told me what winning would have meant.

discoveryAnswers.5_cup_AFTER: The trophy AND the name of the optional 4-week end playoff ('Cup Final'); the Pro can switch to a points table.
discoveryAnswers.6_competing_for_BEFORE: 'The cup' — bragging rights or money, unknown.
discoveryAnswers.6_competing_for_AFTER: A cash pot (default $75/player hidden behind Customize; I set $25) split 60/25/15 champ/runner-up/Points King, plus Most Improved, Iron Man, badges.
discoveryAnswers.7_against_whom_BEFORE: My buddies; individual vs team unknown.
discoveryAnswers.7_against_whom_AFTER: My squad vs the other squad(s) by default (2 squads); individually vs everyone for Points King.
discoveryAnswers.8_rounds_BEFORE: Go play anywhere, type the score in; gross/net/course relevance unknown.

discoveryAnswers.noticed_3s: Flag logo, 'CUP SEASON', 'crew', two buttons — a golf thing for a group.
discoveryAnswers.understood_10s: Post real scores; there is a prize; bring friends; someone else could have sent a code.
discoveryAnswers.could_do_30s: Only tap Continue with email. No learn-more, no how-it-works, no pricing before sign-up.

issues.screen: Wizard step 3 — Lock the bylaws & form the squads
issues.observation: Tapped [Lock the bylaws & form the squads]; a white toast 'Lock failed. Something went wrong — please try again.' showed for ~1.5 s and the screen did not change. Repeated 6 times (incl. Back → Solo → Next → Lock). Console each time: '[cs] error: Lock failed. staged is not defined'. After reloading, Home read 'DESERT DOGS · SEASON LIVE — The season's on. Rounds count from today. ROSTER 1 IN' — the FIRST attempt (2 squads) had succeeded; the later Solo choice was silently discarded.
issues.expected: Lock succeeds once and shows the invite/success screen; or a real failure leaves nothing locked.
issues.actual: Server locked the league on tap 1; client crashed afterward and reported failure five more times; user only learns by reloading.
issues.recommendation: Fix the 'staged' reference error; on any post-lock exception re-fetch league state and render success; never show a retry toast after a committed server write.
issues.evidence: ../screenshots/nov/30-after-lock.jpg, 31-lock-retry-immediate.jpg, 33-lock-fail-toast.jpg (toast visible), 34-reload-home.jpg; console '[cs] error: Lock failed. staged is not defined' ×6; timeline 13:31:21–13:33:37
issues.impact: The organizer's single most important action reports failure; a novice abandons or creates duplicate leagues; later structural choices are lost without notice.
issues.interpretation: Client-side ReferenceError after a successful RPC.
issues.timeOrAttempts: 6 attempts over ~2 min, then a reload
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: the app is broken and my league does not exist. ACTUAL: the league was live after tap 1.

issues.observation: The Standard card and [Use these defaults →] never mention money. Only after tapping [Customize] does 'Buy-in · Per player · $0 = bragging rights · $75' appear as the pre-set value, along with Season length 6 mo, Teams, endgame, pot split.
issues.expected: Money is a first-class, visible decision with a $0 default.
issues.actual: A $75-per-player stake is the hidden default behind an optional disclosure.
issues.recommendation: Show buy-in (and season length, teams) above the fold or as its own step; default $0; restate buy-in on the lock confirmation.
issues.evidence: ../screenshots/nov/18-wizard-customize.jpg, 19-wizard-customize-full.jpg (Buy-in $75 under 'Hide options'); 15-wizard-step2.jpg shows no money mention
issues.impact: A Pro who trusts 'defaults' commits friends to $75 each without seeing it — the exact risk the Prize Pool Disclaimer warns about.
issues.interpretation: Defaults were tuned for a serious league, not for a first-time organizer.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: 'Use these defaults' = fairness rules only. ACTUAL: it also fixes a $75 buy-in and a 6-month season.

issues.screen: Home vs Clubhouse › Standings vs Post form
issues.observation: Home: 'SEASON LIVE — The season's on. Rounds count from today.' Clubhouse 10 s later: 'BEFORE FIRST TEE — First tee Sat Sep 5 — KICKS OFF IN 7 DAYS · PRACTICE ROUNDS HIT YOUR CARD, NOT THE SEASON'. Post form: 'LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 5'. After posting, Standings: Dana R 0 · 0 pts, COUNTING ROUNDS 0/4 · August.
issues.expected: One consistent statement of whether today's round counts.
issues.actual: Three screens give three answers; the round earned 0 league points after the form promised 5.
issues.recommendation: Compute one season-state string and use it everywhere; the post form and posted card must say 'practice · season starts Sep 5' when applicable.
issues.impact: The novice cannot answer 'did that round count?' — the first question a buddy asks.
issues.interpretation: Season status (locked/live) and first-tee gating are computed by different code paths.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: I earned 5 points. ACTUAL: 0 — it was a pre-season practice round.

issues.screen: Post form preview · Round receipt · You tab
issues.observation: Form: '-3.7 VS YOUR INDEX' beside 'Rough one' and 5 pts. Receipt: 'Against your number -3.7 — POSTED ANYWAY'. You tab: 'Best vs index -3.7 · Career best'. Posted card: '3.7 over your number' (correct wording). Differential 21.9 vs index 18.2 = 3.7 WORSE.
issues.expected: Minus means under/better, as in golf.
issues.actual: Minus means worse on three screens; one screen uses the right words.
issues.recommendation: Always render with a word: '+3.7 over' / '2.1 under'; never a bare signed number.
issues.impact: Golfers misread their own result; 'career best -3.7' for a bottom-band round is nonsensical.
issues.interpretation: Internal sign convention (index − differential) leaked into UI.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: I beat my index by 3.7, why only 5 points? ACTUAL: I was 3.7 worse.

issues.observation: [Add golfers] searches only existing accounts ('Find golfers by name or @handle'); typing my friend's email or 'Mike' → 'No golfers found. Invite links still work for everyone else.' [Share the invite link] and [Share an invite link instead] each produced a 1.5-s toast 'Invite code: DESEUU0K' with no URL shown, no copy confirmation, no share sheet in this browser. No invited/pending state exists anywhere.
issues.expected: A visible, copyable invite link; invite by email/phone; a tracker of who has been invited/joined.
issues.actual: The invite is a code in a vanishing toast; friends without accounts cannot be invited from inside the app.
issues.recommendation: Show the link as selectable text with Copy and native Share; add email/SMS invite; show 'invited · joined · N needed to tee off' on Home.
issues.evidence: ../screenshots/nov/44-members.jpg, 45-share-link.jpg, 46-add-golfers.jpg, 47-search-email.jpg, 48-share-instead.jpg; toast text captured via DOM: 'Invite code: DESEUU0K'
issues.impact: The persona's entire job ('you set it up') ends at a dead end; nothing tracks friends who never join.
issues.interpretation: Share relies on navigator.share/clipboard with a weak fallback.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: something was copied to my clipboard. ACTUAL: unknown; clipboard read denied; no confirmation.

issues.observation: Footer: 'Lock opens the invite link — one link fills the league; anyone can also join later with the league code. Minimum four to tee off.' First mention of a minimum. The league then locked with 1 player and Home says SEASON LIVE, Standings say SQUADS LOCKED.
issues.expected: Minimum players stated on step 1; enforced or clearly shown as 'waiting for 3 more'.
issues.actual: Revealed last, then contradicted.
issues.recommendation: State the minimum on step 1 and on Home ('1 of 4 in'); block or clearly stage the season until met.
issues.impact: A 3-person group learns the constraint after committing and then sees it ignored.

issues.observation: '2 Squads' is highlighted (class=on), the caption reads '4 squads · the full cup experience for 8+ players.', and an orange note says '1 golfer staged — solo fits. Bigger squads open up as more join, by code or invite.'
issues.expected: Caption describes the selected option.
issues.actual: Three contradictory signals on one control.
issues.recommendation: Bind the caption to the selection; make the staged-count hint a recommendation.
issues.impact: I could not tell what structure I was choosing; kept the default without understanding it.

issues.screen: Clubhouse › League › League rules & Pro Shop › How scoring & handicaps work
issues.observation: The only full explanation of points, index, floor, bye and money is the 'How scoring works' sheet, reached via Clubhouse → League → expand '▶ LEAGUE RULES & PRO SHOP' → [How scoring & handicaps work →] (also under You › How it works). Nothing on Home, Standings, the post form or the wizard links to it.
issues.expected: Rules reachable from where the numbers appear.
issues.actual: Four taps deep behind a collapsed disclosure.
issues.recommendation: Link 'How scoring works' from the Standings header, the point-bands panel on the post form, and wizard step 2.
issues.impact: The best copy in the product is undiscoverable at the moment of confusion.

issues.observation: Tapped [Draw squads] with 1 in the pool: toast 'Draw failed. Something went wrong — please try again.' Console: 'Draw failed. Not enough golfers to cover every squad — 1 in, 2 squads. Share the invite link first.'
issues.expected: The specific, actionable message.
issues.actual: Generic error; the helpful sentence is only in the console.
issues.recommendation: Surface user-facing server messages verbatim.
issues.impact: User retries a hopeless action instead of inviting.

issues.observation: Card reads 'Squads · Complete · rosters locked [View]'; tapping View shows 'FORM SQUADS · BLIND DRAW — 1 in the pool — Squad 1 · 0 PLAYERS · Empty — Squad 2 · 0 PLAYERS · Empty — [Draw squads]'. Standings also say 'SQUADS LOCKED'.
issues.expected: Status derived from the actual roster.
issues.actual: Card and screen disagree.
issues.recommendation: Show 'Not drawn · 1 of 4 in' until the draw runs.
issues.impact: Organizer believes squads are done.

issues.screen: Wizard step 2 cards · step 3 review · live round
issues.observation: Standard card: 'GHIN rounds'; review for Standard: 'VERIFICATION Attested'; Cutthroat card: 'verified + attested · rated tees · receipts required'. 'Attested' is defined only on the live scoring screen ('Scores entered together are auto-attested').
issues.expected: One word per verification level with a one-line definition where chosen.
issues.actual: Inconsistent, undefined at decision time; contradicts the golfer-card line that GHIN is 'identity, not your number'.
issues.recommendation: Define each level on its card: 'Attested = scored live by your group or confirmed by a partner'.
issues.impact: The Pro cannot tell friends what will be demanded when they post.

issues.observation: Receipt shows the formula but has only [Close]; the posted card has [Share the card] / [Back to the board]. The only delete is an unlabeled ✕ on You › Recent rounds (accessible name 'Delete round').
issues.expected: 'Wrong score/course? Delete this round' at the point of need.
issues.actual: No edit/delete path discoverable from the round itself.
issues.recommendation: Add a delete (with confirm) on the receipt and posted card; explain that rounds are re-posted, not edited.
issues.impact: Q9 'what if something goes wrong' has no discoverable answer.

issues.observation: 'SEASON RACE · THE CLIMB — 01 Squad 1 0 — TOP SEED · +10 — 02 Squad 2 0 -0 — TOP 1 ADVANCE · PROJECTED UNDER A GENEROUS CEILING'; table headers 'SQUAD · TREND · Δ WK · PTS', rows 'CAPT. — · WK 1 · 0 · 0'.
issues.expected: Projections hidden until data exists; 'seed', 'advance', 'captain' explained.
issues.actual: Jargon badges for two empty squads.
issues.recommendation: Replace with an honest empty state ('Invite 3 more to draw squads'); define terms inline once data appears.
issues.impact: The first thing the organizer sees after locking is meaningless.

issues.observation: 'Every individual dial unlocks with Pro Shop.' and 'Live draft night… is on the Pro Shop roadmap.' appear in the wizard; 'Pro Shop' is defined only on the League tab as 'CUP SEASON MEMBERSHIP · COMING AT LAUNCH · THE PILOT RIDES FREE'.
issues.expected: No undefined paid tier referenced during setup.
issues.actual: Term used three times before definition; 'the pilot' ambiguous.
issues.recommendation: Say 'paid membership (coming)' or drop the reference from the wizard.
issues.impact: Novice can't tell whether this league will cost anything.

issues.observation: 'Monthly floor · 2 rounds a month. Miss it and your squad loses 5 points for every round you're short. Short months are waived.' shown before any league exists; 'squad' undefined.
issues.expected: League rules appear only inside a league.
issues.actual: Rule text leaks to a user with no league.
issues.recommendation: Hide until in a league; define 'squad' on first use.
issues.impact: First exposure to 'squad' and penalties is context-free.

issues.observation: 'COUNTING ROUNDS 0 / 4 · August · your best 4 count' while the season starts Sep 5 and the card above says practice rounds don't count.
issues.expected: Show the first counting month.
issues.actual: Counting August for a September season.
issues.recommendation: 'Counting starts September'.
issues.impact: Reinforces the 'does it count?' confusion.

issues.observation: Entered Handicap index 18.2 on the golfer card; Home immediately says 'Three rounds and your index goes live. Nothing else needed. INDEX 0 OF 3'; Clubhouse later shows 'YOUR INDEX 18.2'.
issues.expected: 'Starter 18.2 · 0 of 3 rounds until your scores take over'.
issues.actual: The typed number vanishes from Home.
issues.recommendation: Show the starter on Home with the 0/3 progress.
issues.impact: A 20-year golfer thinks the app threw away their handicap.

issues.observation: 'Cup Final: the last four weeks reset and score fresh — top seeds only, whoever's hottest takes the cup.' Nothing says how many seeds, what non-seeds do, or how a squad wins 60% of the pot.
issues.expected: A worked example.
issues.actual: Under-specified; confidence 4/10.
issues.recommendation: Add 'With 2 squads: both advance; with 4: top 2…' and 'the champ squad splits 60%'.
issues.impact: The organizer cannot explain the endgame to the group.

issues.observation: Stepping −/+ yields None → $25 → $50 → $75 → $100 → $150 → $200; one − from $75 goes straight to None.
issues.expected: Free entry or $5 steps.
issues.actual: Cannot set $10 or $20.
issues.recommendation: Numeric input with sensible presets.
issues.evidence: DOM readout during 13:28–13:29 (values listed in report); 19-wizard-customize-full.jpg
issues.impact: Friendly low stakes impossible.

issues.screen: Home tile 'NEXT · Open · PLAN A ROUND'
issues.observation: Tile opens the calendar/tee sheet. I read 'Next · Open' for 20 minutes as 'the next league round is open'.
issues.expected: Label says what it is.
issues.actual: Ambiguous label.
issues.recommendation: 'TEE SHEET · nothing planned · PLAN ONE'.
issues.impact: Misleads about league structure.

issues.screen: Schedule calendar · day sheet · standings headers
issues.observation: Grey dots on Sat Sep 5 and every Sunday; tapping Sun Sep 6 → '1 ON THE SHEET · Week closes — snapshot recorded'. Season starts Saturday, weeks close Sunday, caps/floors are monthly; 'Δ WK' in standings; 'snapshot' undefined.
issues.expected: One explanation of season/week/month.
issues.actual: Three clocks, nowhere explained; week 1 is effectively one day.
issues.recommendation: A 'How the calendar works' line on Schedule; don't count a week-close marker as 'on the sheet'.
issues.impact: The app never tells the user when to play or what a week means.

issues.observation: Stepper shows '–'; the first + sets the hole to par, each further + adds one. Six taps on a par 5 produced 10, not 6.
issues.expected: Visible starting value or 'tap + to start at par'.
issues.actual: Unannounced behaviour.
issues.recommendation: Start at par visibly, or label the first tap.
issues.impact: Wrong hole-1 scores in real rounds.

issues.screen: LIVE set up — Game for this round
issues.observation: Wolf: 'A round of Wolf — needs four. We run the rotation and the side tally; scores still post.' Sunningdale Rules: '…go 2 down and you get a stroke… bank a unit.' No how-to-play anywhere; Nassau absent.
issues.expected: 3-line rules per game.
issues.actual: Game names assumed known.
issues.recommendation: Add an (i) per game; consider Nassau.
issues.impact: A 20-year golfer who never played Wolf can't pick it.

issues.screen: Live round settlement · Pot › Post a stake
issues.observation: Live: 'ROUND SETTLEMENT · LIVE — DANA → MIKE $2'. Pot tab: 'THE OTHER STAKES · PRIDE, ON THE BOOKS — Post a stake — Pride, on the books — never money… The pot stays money; this never is.' Nowhere keeps side-game cash after the round.
issues.expected: The app that 'keeps the books' archives the settle-up.
issues.actual: Side-game dollars vanish after the round; 'stake' means non-money.
issues.recommendation: Archive live settlements into the record/Pot, or state up front they aren't kept.
issues.impact: The bar argument the app promises to prevent is exactly the one it doesn't record.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: skins money goes on the Pot ledger. ACTUAL: only pride stakes are logged.

issues.observation: Three stacked dialogs: 'Round posted' card → 'Get the full-screen app… [Add]' → 'Welcome to the season ⛳' with 'Your first round is on the board' listed twice and a 'Turn off this link — The page stops working for everyone who has it' control for a link I never created.
issues.expected: One celebration; share secondary; no destructive control in a welcome.
issues.actual: Dialog pile-up with a confusing link toggle.
issues.recommendation: Merge into one card; move 'Turn off this link' to the share flow.
issues.impact: Post-round moment is noisy and slightly alarming.

issues.observation: Posted card: '91 · 3.7 over your number · COUNTS ON YOUR CARD'; receipt shows the differential math but no points and no league mention.
issues.expected: '5 pts to Squad 1' or 'Practice — season starts Sep 5'.
issues.actual: 'Counts on your card' reads as 'counted'; points never stated after posting.
issues.recommendation: State points and season status on the posted card and receipt.
issues.impact: Q10 unanswerable without visiting Standings.

issues.screen: LIVE set up — Add a guest
issues.observation: Guest row has an 'Add' button; the persistent 'Get the full-screen app… [Add] [✕]' banner also says 'Add'. My tap hit the wrong one and an 'Add to the foursome' search sheet opened.
issues.expected: Distinct labels; banner dismissed on task screens.
issues.actual: Two 'Add' buttons on one screen.
issues.recommendation: Label 'Add guest'; suppress the banner during setup/live scoring.
issues.impact: Setup friction; a lost guest entry.

issues.observation: Returning from the legal page and on a subsequent reload, the signed-in user saw the sign-in door for ~6–8 s before Home appeared; console '[cs] Boot stalled at [league-data] — network or auth hang'. Every boot also logs '[live-resume] server query failed: Could not embed because more than one relationship was found for live_rounds and live_round_players'.
issues.expected: A loading state, not the sign-in screen.
issues.actual: Looks logged out for several seconds; live-round resume query errors silently.
issues.recommendation: Show a splash/loading state until session resolves; fix the live_rounds embed ambiguity.
issues.impact: Every cold open reads as 'signed out'; a resume-live-round feature is probably broken.

issues.observation: 'Cancel & delete this league (only possible before the first tee)' in red is the third line of the league card; 'Code · DESEUU0K' and 'Add golfers' are the last elements of a very long Standings page.
issues.expected: Invite is the primary action until 4 have joined.
issues.actual: Delete outranks invite.
issues.recommendation: Put Code + Share at the top of the league card until the minimum is met; demote delete.
issues.impact: Organizer hunts for the one thing they need.

issues.observation: 'Links your USGA record — that's identity, not your number. Your index still comes from your posted scores.' Settings later says: 'A reference on your card — we never resell or verify it. Leave it blank if you'd rather not.'
issues.expected: The clear version on the card.
issues.actual: Cryptic first exposure.
issues.recommendation: Reuse the settings wording.
issues.impact: Golfers with a GHIN don't know why to enter it.

issues.observation: Tapping [Start the league] with an empty name did nothing — no message, no shake.
issues.expected: Inline validation.
issues.actual: Silent no-op.
issues.recommendation: 'Give it a name to continue'.
issues.impact: Feels broken.

issues.observation: Button says 'Start the league'; result is a 3-step 'Create your league' wizard, and a toast 'Desert Dogs is on the books — set the bylaws' shows the league already exists.
issues.expected: 'Next: set the rules'.
issues.actual: Label overpromises; league exists before any rule is set.
issues.recommendation: Rename the button; or create the league at lock.
issues.impact: Novice unsure what has been committed.

issues.observation: 'Cups & events · 1 · Played in' after zero events; 'YOUR DISPLAY CASE — No hardware yet' seconds after 'You broke 100 for the first time · Pinned to your card'; 'FIRST TEE SUN SEP 5' though Sep 5 is Saturday.
issues.expected: Accurate counters and dates.
issues.actual: Three wrong facts on the profile.
issues.recommendation: Fix counters; weekday from the real date.
issues.impact: Undermines trust in 'everything shows its work'.

issues.observation: The orange + FAB covers 'AROUND YOUR BUDDIES' text on Home and the wizard's summary sentence; the live 'NO SKINS CLAIMED YET' sticky bar overlaps the attest paragraph.
issues.expected: Content clears fixed elements.
issues.actual: Overlaps at default scroll.
issues.recommendation: Bottom padding / safe-area on scroll containers.
issues.impact: Polish.

issues.observation: Season-length label reads '2 mo' for both 'Sep 5 – Nov 14' and 'Sep 5 – Oct 31'; Papago Golf Course listed twice in course search; Home round card renders 91 as two digit tiles read as '9 1 gross'.
issues.expected: Consistent labels and de-duplicated results.
issues.actual: Small inconsistencies.
issues.recommendation: Label in weeks under 3 months; dedupe courses; keep the odometer accessible name simple.
issues.impact: Polish.

issues.observation: Footer reads 'v23 · __CS_VERSION__'; the email subject is 'Confirm your email address' while the screen says 'Type the sign-in code'.
issues.expected: A real version and matching wording.
issues.actual: Placeholder text and a mismatch.
issues.recommendation: Stamp the version; subject 'Your Cup Season sign-in code'.
issues.impact: Looks unfinished; inbox scanning friction.

issues.screen: Scoring sheet · post form · receipt · onboarding
issues.observation: Same point band labelled 'Rough day, posted anyway' (form), 'Posted anyway · rough day' (sheet), 'POSTED ANYWAY' (receipt); the Post tab is 'The ⊕' in onboarding and 'Post' in the tab bar; 'invite link' vs 'invite code'.
issues.expected: One name per concept.
issues.actual: Multiple names.
issues.recommendation: A single vocabulary list enforced across screens.
issues.impact: Cumulative confusion debt.

issues.observation: Button reads 'Save card' until you type, then becomes 'Save changes'; tapping 'Save card' with untouched fields toasts 'Card saved'. City/home course were never offered during onboarding and live two levels deep; saving them took 4 attempts.
issues.expected: Stable button; home course asked on the golfer card.
issues.actual: Label swap and a no-op success toast.
issues.recommendation: Keep one label; disable until dirty; add city/home course to onboarding as optional.
issues.impact: Polish; the persona's home course was hard to set.

explanation30s: Cup Season is a fantasy-league thing for our actual golf. I set up a league, we each throw in twenty-five bucks, and the app splits us into two squads. Then you just go play golf wherever, whenever, and post your score — it works out how you did against your own handicap and gives you five to twelve points, so a bad day still gets you five. Your best four rounds a month count for your squad, and if you don't post at least two a month your squad gets docked. It runs thirteen weeks; the last four weeks are a 'Cup Final' where the top squads start fresh and whoever's hottest wins the pot. There's also a live mode for skins or match play when we're actually out together, and you can drag guys in as guests without them having an account. Honestly, the setup asked me a bunch of stuff I didn't understand and it told me it failed when it hadn't, but once it's running the round-posting part is slick.

personaVerdict.question: Can this person create/join a season and understand the rules without outside instruction?
personaVerdict.answer: Create — yes, barely, and the app told me I had failed (six 'Lock failed' toasts while the league was in fact live). Understand the rules — about half, and only by digging: a patient novice who opens every (i) and finds You › How it works can reconstruct the scoring and money model, but cannot confidently answer 'how do we win the Cup Final', 'do this week's rounds count', 'what does 95% do', or 'how do I get my friends in' — the four questions buddies ask first. The most consequential trap is a hidden $75-per-player default buy-in behind 'Customize'. The round-posting flow and the live skins ledger are genuinely good; the organizer's path — this persona's whole job — is where the bugs, hidden defaults, contradictions and dead ends live.

explanation30s: It's a fantasy-league-style golf season for our group. We're split into two squads by a blind draw. Every real round you play — anywhere, any course — you post your score and the app scores it against your own handicap: crush your number and it's 12 points, play to it and it's 7, even a bad day is 5 as long as you post. Your best four rounds a month count for your squad, and you have to post at least two a month or the squad loses points. It runs four months, then the last four weeks are a fresh 'Cup Final' and the hot squad takes the cup. Fifty bucks in, the app keeps the tab, winners split it 60/25/15 and we pay each other. And when we actually play together you can run match play or Wolf in it and it tells you who owes who at the end.

personaVerdict.question: Is creating and running a season simple enough that one person will actually do it?
personaVerdict.answer: Not today. The wizard itself is well designed — one preset, dials behind Customize, explainers on every dial, a review table — and took ~10 minutes to understand fully. But the one button that completes it ('Lock the bylaws & form the squads') failed six times with a JavaScript error (`staged is not defined`) and no visible message; the invite the copy said 'opens on lock' was already open and I found the code THEPTCQ5 by accident in the league room; there is no email/SMS invite, only a code to relay by hand and a search of strangers; 'Draw squads' hid a helpful server message behind a generic one; the install banner covered the ⊕; the league's status is described four different ways; buy-in defaulted to a hidden $75; and the rules my friends need are four taps deep behind a collapsed panel. Fix the lock bug and add a real invite and this is a 7.

issues.expected: Copy reflects membership.
issues.actual: Wrong-state boilerplate.
issues.recommendation: Condition on membership and season window (see ORG-05).
issues.impact: Adds to the confusion about whether the round counted.

issues.observation: 'Monthly floor · 2 rounds a month. Miss it and your squad loses 5 points for every round you're short. Short months are waived.' shown before any league exists.
issues.expected: No league rules until in a league.
issues.actual: A rule about a 'squad' I don't have.
issues.recommendation: Hide until a league is joined; define 'short months'.
issues.impact: First screen introduces three undefined terms (floor, squad, short months).

issues.screen: Wizard buy-in / Pot tab / Live setup stake / Post a stake sheet
issues.observation: 'Buy-in' (wizard), 'The pot' + 'Post a stake · Pride, on the books — never money' (Pot tab), 'Stake per side · $0 = bragging rights' (live match play, real money), '$5 on the line' (board).
issues.expected: Distinct names for money vs pride bets.
issues.actual: 'Stake' means money on one screen and explicitly not-money on another.
issues.recommendation: Rename Pot-tab pride bets ('Bounty'/'Wager of pride'); note on the Pot tab that side-game cash settles between players and is not in the pot.
issues.impact: Organizer cannot explain the money model in one sentence.

issues.observation: The floating ⊕ overlaps explanatory copy: 'Standard: 95% handicap, [⊕]osted rounds…' and 'posts the reve[⊕]gument-proof.'
issues.expected: Copy readable.
issues.actual: FAB covers text on the wizard.
issues.recommendation: Hide the FAB during the wizard, or pad the wizard bottom.
issues.impact: Key explanatory sentences partially unreadable.

issues.screen: League tab → Share the season → Link
issues.observation: Status: 'Could not make the link. Please sign in again.' Console: "Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied." I was signed in.
issues.expected: Show the URL as text when clipboard fails; honest error.
issues.actual: Wrong diagnosis told to the user.
issues.recommendation: Separate 'link creation' from 'copy'; always render the link; message the actual failure.
issues.impact: Users will sign out/in for nothing; public standings page unreachable.

issues.observation: Headline 'Round posted · 0 CARDS TO THE SEASON' with 'Casey · NOT POSTED · INCOMPLETE CARD'.
issues.expected: Headline matches outcome ('Round finished — nothing posted').
issues.actual: Contradictory headline.
issues.recommendation: Conditional headline.
issues.impact: Player may believe an incomplete round was posted.

issues.observation: The Pro is never shown the join covenant ('Welcome to The Papago Grind · THREE THINGS TO KNOW' — which lists four bullets incl. 'You're on the pot sheet: $50 buy-in'). I only saw it by opening the join URL myself.
issues.expected: 'Preview what your friends will see' on the invite sheet.
issues.actual: No preview; heading count wrong.
issues.recommendation: Add a preview to Add golfers / Share; fix 'three things' to match the bullets.
issues.impact: Organizer can't vouch for what friends will be told about money.

issues.observation: Handle prefilled '@jerechoblind1' silently became '@casey' as I typed my name ('@casey is available ✓'). Settings later say 'Handle · moves once / 60 days'.
issues.expected: Tell me the handle follows the name and that it locks.
issues.actual: Silent auto-change and an undisclosed lock.
issues.recommendation: Show 'Handle follows your name until you edit it · changeable once per 60 days' on the card.
issues.impact: Minor surprise; potential regret.

issues.screen: Name your league sheet; Live setup 'Add a guest'
issues.observation: 'Start the league' with an empty name did nothing (no message). Guest 'Add' with an empty name did nothing (no message).
issues.expected: Inline validation.
issues.actual: Silent no-ops.
issues.recommendation: Disable the button until valid or show 'Give it a name'.
issues.impact: Wasted taps; feels broken.

issues.observation: 'v23 · __CS_VERSION__' placeholder visible.
issues.expected: A real version or nothing.
issues.actual: Developer placeholder on the first screen.
issues.recommendation: Stamp or hide in local/dev builds.
issues.impact: Small trust ding for an organizer about to recruit six people.

issues.observation: 'THE POT $50 · $30 CUP CHAMPS · $13 RUNNER-UP · $8 POINTS KING' (= $51). 'Cup champs' plural with no per-member split for a 2-squad league. The ☐ next to my name is unlabeled.
issues.expected: Amounts that add to the pot; per-member payout; labeled 'paid' checkbox.
issues.actual: Rounding shown as truth; split per squad member unknown.
issues.recommendation: Use exact cents or 'about'; show 'per squad member'; label the checkbox 'Paid the Pro'.
issues.impact: Money screen invites nitpicks.

issues.observation: 'Papago' returns two identical rows 'Papago Golf Course · Phoenix, AZ · 13 tees'.
issues.expected: One result, or distinguishing detail.
issues.actual: Duplicate with no way to choose.
issues.recommendation: Dedupe by course id; show address/holes if truly distinct.
issues.impact: Hesitation on every post.

issues.observation: 'CUPS & EVENTS · 1 · Played in' with zero played; persists after deleting my only round.
issues.actual: Counts membership as 'played in'.
issues.recommendation: Count only leagues/events with at least one counted round or a finished season.
issues.impact: Record looks padded.

issues.screen: You tab → Recent rounds ✕; round receipt
issues.observation: The receipt has no edit/delete. The only correction is a small ✕ ('Delete round') on the You tab; it fires a native browser confirm ('Delete this round? It leaves your card and any league standings it counted toward.') with no undo. No edit exists.
issues.expected: Correction path from the receipt; in-app confirm; guidance to re-post.
issues.actual: Hidden delete, browser dialog, no edit.
issues.recommendation: Add 'Fix this round' on the receipt → delete + re-post with prefilled fields; in-app confirm sheet.
issues.impact: Wrong scores in a money league are hard to fix and easy to lose.

issues.observation: After customizing, 'Use these defaults →' advanced to review with my $50 / 4 mo intact.
issues.expected: Label matches behavior.
issues.actual: Label implies a reset; behaves as Next.
issues.recommendation: Relabel to 'Next →' once anything is customized.
issues.impact: Organizer fears losing settings.

issues.observation: Date '2026-08-29' (ISO) while other screens say 'Sat Aug 29'; league points absent; allowance not shown.
issues.expected: Consistent date; points line; allowance used.
issues.actual: Partial receipt.
issues.recommendation: Add 'League points: 6 (or: none — before first tee)' and 'index used: 14.2 × 95% = 13.5' lines; format date.
issues.impact: The 'show its work' promise stops one line short.

issues.observation: First '+' tap sets the hole score to par (5 on a par 5); each further tap +1. Expected 1.
issues.expected: Stepper starts at par visibly (show par as placeholder in the box).
issues.actual: Surprising first tap.
issues.recommendation: Render the par in the score box as a ghost value before the first tap.
issues.impact: Mis-scores on hole 1 for new users.

issues.observation: 'Sunningdale Rules' offered with no (i); each game's player-count rule and stake field appear only after selecting it.
issues.expected: Short descriptions visible before selection.
issues.actual: Trial-and-error selection.
issues.recommendation: Show a one-liner under each chip or an (i).
issues.impact: Minor; discourages trying unfamiliar formats.

issues.observation: Terms/Privacy open a new tab with no in-app feedback. The Prize Pool Disclaimer ('a golf league management app for private groups who play real, handicapped golf together… does not collect, hold, transfer, or distribute money') explains the product's model better than the door.
issues.expected: The door says what the product is; legal is legal.
issues.actual: Best product summary lives in legal fine print.
issues.recommendation: Put a one-line 'what this is' and 'money stays between friends' on the door or interstitial.
issues.impact: Organizers skimming the door can't pitch it to friends.

confusionDebt: That 'league', 'season', 'cup' and 'event' are four different nouns with different lifetimes — never defined together.
What a round is worth (the 5–12 point bands) — needed before the wizard's dials, shown only after (post form, hidden explainer).
That squads exist and that I'd be choosing a team structure for seven people, including how 3 v 4 is scored.
What 'lock' freezes and when (three different answers across screens); that the invite code exists before any lock.
That the index I typed is a 'starter' the app will overwrite after 3 rounds, and that the 95% allowance changes it invisibly.
Golf-handicap vocabulary: differential, slope, rating, stroke index, rated tees, attested, honor scores.
That 'GHIN rounds' under Standard does not actually require GHIN (verification reads 'Attested').
What 'seeds', '+10 head start' and 'cut line after 2nd' mean for the Cup Final.
That a round posted before the first tee gives 0 league points even though the form says 6.
That the invite is a code, that friends must download the app and tap 'I have an invite code', and what they will be told (the covenant) when they do.
That 'Findable by: All' is on by default and that anyone in the app can add me — or a stranger — to a league.
Who pays for 'membership', how much, and when it 'lands'.
That '-1.7 vs your index' means over, not under.
That side games exist, live under the ⊕ LIVE door, post to the board, and do not touch the season table or the pot.
That the league's rules live under League sub-tab → a collapsed 'League rules & Pro Shop' panel.
That 'Use these defaults →' just means Next.
What 'Sunningdale Rules', 'Wolf', 'skins carry' and 'net best ball' are.
That the ✕ on a round on the You tab deletes it (browser confirm, no undo, no edit).
That the install banner must be dismissed before the ⊕ works.
That 'Share the season' is a public standings page, and that 'the pilot rides free'.
blockers: Lock the bylaws / form the squads: JavaScript error `staged is not defined` on every attempt (6 tries, two entry points, after reload) — league setup never completed; squads never formed; Cup Final / squad standings never observed.
No email/phone invite path — could not invite the six friends from inside the app; only the code THEPTCQ5 (and the never-displayed link https://cupseason.app/?join=THEPTCQ5) can be relayed by hand.

Headless browser had no navigator.share and clipboard read/write denied — every 'Copy'/'Share' payload (invite link text, guest recap link, season link, settlement) was unobservable; 'Share the season' and 'Copy link' errored.
Season first tee is Sep 5 (a week out) — could not observe a round scoring into league standings, month close, floor penalties or the Cup Final.

Blind rule: single account — a friend's join experience was observed only by opening /?join=THEPTCQ5 in my own signed-in session; the signed-out join flow and 'Members & invites' with real joiners were not observed.

Server-side warning on every Home load after a live round: '[live-resume] server query failed: Could not embed because more than one relationship was found for live_rounds and live_round_players' — did not visibly break anything but may affect 'Continue your round'.

issues.observation: Home card reads "WHO'S THE BITCH? · WEEK 4 OF 14"; Clubhouse card reads "WK 4 / 13", "Mon Aug 3 → Mon Nov 2 · 13 wks" and the stat tile "W4 / 13".
issues.expected: The season length is the same number on every screen.
issues.actual: 14 weeks on Home, 13 weeks on Clubhouse (and Aug 3 → Nov 2 is 13 weeks).
issues.interpretation: One of the two screens computes weeks differently (likely an inclusive/exclusive or a week-of vs. total mismatch).
issues.impact: A first-timer's first two screens disagree about the most basic fact of the season; trust in every other number drops.
issues.recommendation: Derive the week label from one source and show it identically on Home and Clubhouse.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: the season is 14 weeks. ACTUAL: Clubhouse says 13.

issues.observation: The Board shows one line, "◆ Your league is live — post the first round", under "TODAY · AUG 29", then ~65% empty screen and a "Message the league..." composer.
issues.expected: The Board (linked from Home as "THE BOARD ↗" beside "Show earlier · 18") shows the league's rounds, stories and chat.
issues.actual: One nudge line that contradicts Home (Galen posted a 79 on Aug 23; standings show 19 vs 9) and none of the 18 earlier items.
issues.interpretation: Either the Board is not the same feed Home summarises, or it failed to load history, or the launch hatch opened a different league's board. From the phone alone it reads as an empty, contradictory league.
issues.impact: The screen labelled as the social heart of the league is empty and says nobody has posted; a newcomer would conclude the league is dead or broken.
issues.recommendation: Make the Board show the same history Home summarises; never show a "post the first round" nudge when rounds exist.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: The Board holds the 18 earlier items. ACTUAL: it holds one line dated today.

issues.observation: The AUG 2026 grid renders a completely empty first row, then a row containing only 6, 7, 8 in the Thu/Fri/Sat columns. Aug 1–5 are absent.
issues.expected: Every day of August appears, starting Sat Aug 1.
issues.actual: Five days missing (including season start Mon Aug 3) and a blank row above them.
issues.interpretation: A first-of-month offset bug; the season-start hypothesis fails because Aug 3–5 are inside the season and also missing.
issues.impact: A calendar that skips days is untrustworthy; planned rounds on those dates would be invisible.
issues.recommendation: Fix the month-start offset so the first week renders with days 1–5.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: days before the season are hidden. ACTUAL: Aug 3–5 are in-season and also missing.

issues.observation: Screen begins at "SET UP THE ROUND" with no title bar, no back or close control, and no tab bar. The word "live" never appears.
issues.expected: A named screen with an obvious way out and a sentence about what is being set up.
issues.actual: An untitled full-screen form with no exit visible.
issues.interpretation: The user cannot tell what flow they are in (live scoring? a side game? posting?) or how to abandon it.
issues.impact: Dead-end feeling on a screen that asks for a lot of input.
issues.recommendation: Add a title (what this creates) and a Close/Back control at the top; say in one line how it differs from Post a round.

issues.observation: Home shows "2nd", "— held", "10 points back of the lead." and nothing else about the race. No leader name, no ladder, no league size.
issues.expected: The first screen names who is beating me and how many are playing.
issues.actual: The leader (Galen) is only discoverable on Clubhouse; league size (2) is never stated anywhere.
issues.interpretation: Home optimises for my own number and hides the rival.
issues.impact: "Who's beating me" is the core question of a competition app and the home screen does not answer it.
issues.recommendation: Under "2nd", show a compact two- or three-row ladder with names and points, or at least "10 back of Galen · 2 playing".

issues.observation: Both standings rows carry a gold "LOCKED" pill (Galen 19, You 9) in week 4 of 13.
issues.expected: A badge on every row is either explained or omitted.
issues.actual: "LOCKED" is undefined and applies to everyone, so it carries no information.
issues.interpretation: Could mean seeded into a final, rounds frozen, or roster locked; with 9 weeks to go none of these is obvious.
issues.impact: Users will ask the organiser what LOCKED means.
issues.recommendation: Spell it out ("Seat locked for the final") or drop the badge until it differentiates rows.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: my position is locked for the endgame. ACTUAL: unknown; the app never says.

issues.observation: Home: "Partial month · floors waived". Clubhouse: "August is a short month — no floor to clear. Every round still counts."
issues.expected: A rule term used on two screens is defined once.
issues.actual: "floor" is never defined.
issues.interpretation: Probably a minimum-rounds-per-month requirement with a penalty; I am guessing.
issues.impact: A rule with consequences (presumably a penalty) is only ever referenced by its waiver.
issues.recommendation: First mention: "no monthly minimum (floor) this month".

issues.observation: Stat tile "COUNTING ROUNDS 1 / 4 ●○○○ August · your best 4 count".
issues.expected: I can tell whether 4 is a cap on what scores or a requirement I must hit.
issues.actual: Ambiguous; and how a counting round becomes points is never shown.
issues.impact: The single most actionable number on the screen (how many more rounds should I play this month) is unreadable.
issues.recommendation: "Best 4 rounds each month score · 1 posted" or similar.

issues.observation: "EVERYONE ADVANCES — 2 CONTENDERS, 2 SEATS" in the smallest caps on the screen, directly above the tab bar.
issues.expected: The rule about what the ladder leads to is prominent and names the destination.
issues.actual: "advances" to an unnamed thing; "seats" undefined.
issues.impact: The endgame — the reason the ladder matters — is a footnote.
issues.recommendation: Name the destination ("…to the Cup Final") and give the line the same weight as the ladder header.

issues.observation: League card line: "Mon Aug 3 → Mon Nov 2 · 13 wks · THE PRO · GALEN".
issues.expected: A role label a newcomer can decode.
issues.actual: "THE PRO" could be organiser, best player or current leader; Galen is all three candidates.
issues.recommendation: Use a plain label ("Commissioner: Galen") or add a tooltip-style caption.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: the Pro is the organiser. ACTUAL: not stated.

issues.observation: The serif line "10 back of Galen" is rendered under row 01 (Galen, 19) rather than under row 02 (You, 9).
issues.expected: My deficit sits on my row.
issues.actual: It sits on the leader's row and first reads as a subtitle about Galen.
issues.recommendation: Move the deficit line beneath the user's row (or into the highlighted row).

issues.observation: Profile card's first element is small caps "NO. 2" at the top-left. On Card & settings, "No. 2" is the selected ball marker.
issues.expected: A card's leading label is unambiguous.
issues.actual: "NO. 2" reads as a rank — and the user happens to be 2nd — but is a marker name.
issues.impact: A coincidence today; a lie the day the user is 1st or 5th.
issues.recommendation: Prefix the marker name ("Marker · No. 2") or drop it from the card header.
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: NO. 2 = my rank. ACTUAL: it's the ball marker.

issues.observation: "FRONT 9 GROSS" shows a large grey 41 and "BACK 9 GROSS" a large grey 43; "GROSS —".
issues.expected: Empty fields look empty.
issues.actual: Placeholders are large and only slightly dimmer than a value; they read as a pre-filled round.
issues.impact: A hurried user could tap "Post round" believing a score is entered, or be unsure whether 41/43 is theirs.
issues.recommendation: Use a dash or "—" placeholder, or a much lighter example with the word "e.g.".
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: 41/43 are from my last round. ACTUAL: placeholders.

issues.observation: Preview card copy: "A preview at 100% of your number — your league's own math scores it on the books."
issues.expected: One plain sentence about what happens to my score.
issues.actual: "your number", "100%", "own math", "on the books" — four undefined phrases.
issues.recommendation: "This preview uses your full handicap; your league's rules decide the points."

issues.observation: Four differently named entry points for a round: tab "Post", header button "Play now", Clubhouse card button "Live round", and the untitled "SET UP THE ROUND" screen.
issues.expected: Two clearly distinguished actions: enter a finished score vs. score a round as you play.
issues.actual: Four labels, no differentiation, one of them with no title.
issues.recommendation: Standardise on two names and use them everywhere.

issues.observation: Copy: "The stepper opens on each hole's par — pick your course above and the real pars load." and "Pick who plays with who under the game — pairings, stakes, the lot. … Leave index blank for an estimated 18."
issues.expected: No reference to controls or concepts I haven't met.
issues.actual: "the stepper", "the game", "stakes", "the lot", "estimated 18" are all unexplained.
issues.recommendation: Replace "the stepper" with "hole-by-hole entry"; name the game; write "index 18" explicitly.

issues.observation: Entire screen: "Name your league", a field, "You can rename it any time before the bylaws lock.", "Start the league", "Cancel", then empty space.
issues.expected: A sense of what a league involves and how many steps follow.
issues.actual: No step indicator, no summary; "bylaws lock" undefined; "Start the league" suggests immediate creation.
issues.recommendation: Add "Step 1 of N" and a one-line preview of what comes next; define bylaws on first use.

issues.observation: "The Ryder · Two teams · weekly vs-index duels · first to the clinch" with a green "LIVE" badge; "Bracket … SOON"; "More styles land after the pilot."
issues.expected: Availability vs. currently-running is unambiguous; rules are in plain words.
issues.actual: "LIVE" is the app's word for a running season elsewhere; "vs-index duels", "the clinch", "the pilot" are insider phrases.
issues.recommendation: Use "Available" for formats; write the rule in one sentence ("Two teams; each week you play your handicap; first team to N wins").
issues.userAssumption: USER ASSUMPTION: LIVE = a Ryder is running now. ACTUAL: probably "available"; the header says "Start an event".

issues.observation: "QUIET SINCE YOUR LAST VISIT · Sun, Aug 23 — Galen set a personal best — 79…" appeared ~2 minutes after the previous visit; the same 79 is shown as a round card and as a story card directly below.
issues.expected: A recap shows only what is new since last time, and an event appears once.
issues.actual: A 6-day-old event as the recap, and one event on three cards.
issues.recommendation: Suppress the recap when nothing is new; dedupe the round card and its story.

issues.observation: Orange "+" in the header and orange "+" Post in the tab bar on the same screen.
issues.expected: One primary create action, or two clearly labelled ones.
issues.actual: Two identical glyphs; the header one is unlabelled.
issues.recommendation: Label the header + ("New…") or remove it.

issues.observation: Full-width button "Find a golfer" directly above a text field "Find golfers by name or @handle".
issues.expected: One search affordance.
issues.actual: Two stacked affordances for the same task.
issues.recommendation: Keep the field; drop the button (or make the button open the field).

issues.observation: "REQUESTED" section with rows (mmittels15, Scott Cadotte, zimacasey) each carrying a grey "REQUESTED" pill; no accept/decline visible.
issues.expected: I know whether they asked me or I asked them, and can act.
issues.actual: Direction and action are both absent.
issues.recommendation: Split into "Waiting on you" (Accept/Decline) and "Sent".

issues.observation: The "settings" destination opens "Card & settings" on the "Your card" segment; "Settings" is the unselected second segment.
issues.expected: Settings opens on settings.
issues.actual: Settings are one more tap away and nothing on the card tab hints what they contain.
issues.recommendation: Open on the Settings segment when arriving via the gear, or split into two screens.

issues.observation: "BALL MARKER" grid of 14 named glyphs (The Saguaro, The Island, The Lighthouse, The Lone Tree, The Pews, The Dunes, The Beverage, The Shark, The Azalea, The Jug, The Wee Bridge, No. 2, The Postage Stamp, The Thistle); caption "YOUR PHOTO · THE MARKER ALWAYS BACKS IT UP"; "HANDLE · MOVES ONCE / 60 DAYS".
issues.expected: One line saying what a marker is for.
issues.actual: Half the screen is a grid whose purpose is implied only by "backs it up".
issues.recommendation: Caption: "Your marker is your avatar when there's no photo." Rewrite the handle caption as a sentence.

issues.observation: Galen row: "FRI SEP 4 · QUINTERO GOLF AND COUNTRY CLUB · you lead 1–0 · YOU'RE IN · "Major"".
issues.expected: Each fragment is self-explanatory.
issues.actual: Lead in what (1–0)? In what? Why is "Major" quoted?
issues.recommendation: "Head-to-head vs Galen: you lead 1–0 · You're playing · Round name: Major".

issues.observation: "Put a round on the tee sheet", "ON THE TEE SHEET" section, legend "● ON THE TEE SHEET".
issues.expected: A term with an existing golf meaning is either used that way or introduced.
issues.actual: "tee sheet" (a course's booking book) is used to mean "my planned rounds" without introduction.
issues.recommendation: Say "Plan a round" / "Your planned rounds", or introduce the metaphor once.

explanation30s: It's a golf app where your friends form a league with a name and a code, everyone posts their real rounds — front nine and back nine gross — and your rounds turn into points over a season of about 13 or 14 weeks. There's a standings ladder that shows who's leading and how many points back you are, a board where the league chats and the app posts stories like 'Galen broke 80,' and a calendar where you put planned rounds on the 'tee sheet.' You collect little trophies for things like breaking 90. There's also a 'Ryder' team event. I honestly don't know how points are earned or what you win — it says the pot is 'none, bragging rights.'

personaVerdict.question: Looking only at the phone's screens, does Cup Season tell a first-time golfer what it is and why to care?
personaVerdict.answer: Partly. The screens are handsome and the Home card ('2nd — 10 points back of the lead') is a strong first line; the narrated story cards ('Galen broke 80 for the first time — a 79. That one goes on the wall.') are the best thing in the app. But the phone never explains the game: what a point is, what a floor is, what 'locked' and 'seats' mean, or what winning gets you. The Board — the screen labelled as the social heart — is empty and contradicts the rest of the app; the season length disagrees with itself between two screens; the calendar is missing five days; and the live-round flow has no title and no exit. A first-timer would need the organiser to explain at least six words before the Clubhouse makes sense.

explanation30s: It's an app where a group of friends runs a golf season — ours is like four months. You each chip in fifty bucks into a pot. Every time you play a real round, you type in your score and the app compares it to your own handicap, so it doesn't matter if you shoot 75 or 100 — if you beat your usual number you get more points, and even a terrible round still gets you 5 points, so the only way to let your team down is not playing. You're split into two random squads, and your best few rounds each month count for your squad, but you have to post at least two rounds a month or you lose points. At the end, the winning squad splits most of the pot and the top individual gets a cut. It also does live scoring for skins or match play if you want a side bet while you're out there. Honestly the app doesn't explain most of that — Casey had to.

personaVerdict.question: Can a normal golfer understand this without becoming a golf-league nerd?
personaVerdict.answer: Not from the app alone. The core idea — points against your own number, and you can't hurt your squad by playing badly — is genuinely casual-friendly and I liked it once I found it, but I found it on the last card at the bottom of the You tab, after being asked for $50 via four undefined rows. Everything a casual golfer needs to feel safe (cost, who I pay, how long, what I must do monthly, what I can win, that a bad round can't hurt) exists somewhere but never in the path. And the one number the app put in front of me after my round came back as three contradictory verdicts (-7.3 / 7.3 over / +0.0 played to it) with 0 in the table. Golf-league nerds will decode 'SI', 'attested', 'allowance 95%', 'scored fresh', 'counting cap'; I can't. Posting a round is easy; understanding what it did is not.

explanation30s: It's a fantasy-league-style thing for your regular golf group, but you're the players. Casey sets up a season — ours is September to January — everybody throws fifty bucks in a pot, and the app splits you into two-man squads out of a hat. Then you just play golf wherever you want and type in your score after. It scores every round against your own handicap, so a 15 who shoots 86 gets the same points as a 6 who shoots 77, and even a garbage round gets five points — you only lose by not playing; you owe two rounds a month. Your best four a month count for your squad, there's a points leaderboard on the side, and at the end there's a four-week 'Cup Final' and the winning squad takes most of the pot. It also has a chat and a live scorer for match play and skins. The catch is it's another app, another handicap, and it's free now but they're going to charge for it at launch.

personaVerdict.question: Does Cup Season provide enough obvious value to justify changing behavior?
personaVerdict.answer: Not obviously — not yet. The value is real but not obvious: the door sells a slogan, the email sells nothing, and the first explanation of the game arrives after I've given an email, a profile and $50. The competition engine (every round scored fairly vs your own number, receipts on every figure, a pot ledger with a printed split) is the one thing my spreadsheet cannot do — and it's buried under bylaws, presets, covenants and three kinds of links. My first post failed with 'try again', the share link failed with 'sign in again', and the 5 points I was promised never appeared. Switching cost is a second handicap and a second chat. I'd stay because Casey asked, post my two rounds a month, and keep the group text.

explanation30s: It's a fantasy-style golf league for your group. Casey sets up a season — ours is September to January, fifty bucks each — and the app splits everyone into two squads with a blind draw. Every real round you play, you post: front nine, back nine, which tees. The app scores it against your own handicap, not against anyone else — beat your number by three, twelve points; play to it, seven; blow up, you still get five. Your best four rounds a month count for your squad, and you have to post at least two a month or your squad loses points. The last four weeks are a 'Cup Final' that I think resets everything, but honestly I'm not sure. The winning squad takes sixty percent of the pot, second gets twenty-five, and whoever has the most individual points gets fifteen. There's also a live scorer for match play, skins and wolf when you're actually out there — it settles the five bucks and posts everyone's card. Downside: I posted two rounds and it shows me with zero because the season hasn't started, and it never told me that.

personaVerdict.question: Does Cup Season feel strategically compelling enough to care about all season?
personaVerdict.answer: Half. The per-round band system (12/9/7/6/5 vs your own index), the best-4/month cap and 2/month floor, and the Points King race are real reasons to play an extra round — and the live match-play pencil with attested cards is the strongest hook in the app. But I cannot compute a squad score, the Cup Final ('scored fresh') might make 13 weeks irrelevant, there are no tiebreaks, no head-to-head record, no 'next round matters because' signal, my 6.4 will be overwritten by the app's own index, the 95% allowance is applied nowhere I could find, and the form promised 12 points that the standings silently turned into 0. A competitive player plans around written rules; half of them aren't written.

issues.actual: Silent failure; I typed my own course and rating/slope from memory.
issues.recommendation: Surface search failures inline and offer the manual path explicitly; cache popular local courses.
issues.interpretation: External course API failing; UI swallows the error.
issues.impact: Unfindable home course + hand-typed ratings undermines 'Attested' verification and adds friction to every post.

issues.screen: Golfer card; How scoring works; bylaws
issues.observation: My 6.4 is a 'starting point'; 'once you have 3 posted rounds, your scores take over'; GHIN is 'identity, not your number'. Bylaws say HANDICAP ALLOWANCE 95% but scoring used raw 6.4 (74 → +5.0) and the $5 match gave Casey 9 strokes = 100% of the course-handicap difference.
issues.expected: Clear statement of which index governs (GHIN vs app-computed), how fast it moves, and where the 95% applies.
issues.actual: Three contradictory signals; the 95% is applied nowhere visible.
issues.recommendation: Explain the index policy on the golfer card and in scoring; show the course-handicap math on the match setup line; state where the allowance applies.
issues.interpretation: For a golfer with an established index, the fairness argument is the whole game and it is unexplained.
issues.impact: Distrust of every net number in the app.

issues.observation: 'Your league's exact numbers are in League rules.' — 'League rules' is bold text, not a link; tapping did nothing.
issues.expected: Tap → bylaws table.
issues.actual: Dead end; the numbers (best 4 / mo, 2 / mo) are not on the sheet and the cap appears nowhere in the explainer.
issues.recommendation: Make 'League rules' a link and inline the cap/floor values into the sheet.

issues.observation: Four rows (BUY-IN, PRESET Standard, PARTICIPATION FLOOR, FINISH) with no tap targets; asked to commit $50 under 'PRESET Standard' and 'Cup Final' without either being defined; floor consequence not stated.
issues.expected: Each row expands to its meaning; a 'Read the bylaws' link before 'I'm in for $50'.
issues.actual: Unexplained rows; the full table exists but is only reachable via the organizer's lock wizard or the collapsed League disclosure.
issues.recommendation: Link the covenant to the full bylaws table and define Preset/Cup Final inline.

issues.observation: 'THE PAPAGO GRIND · FORMING · 7 days to first tee' sits above 'MONTH CLOSES in 2 days' and the floor warning 'Miss it and your squad loses 5 points…'.
issues.expected: Pre-season Home should say 'Season starts Sat Sep 5 — rounds before then count on your card only'.
issues.actual: Two contradictory clocks on one screen.
issues.recommendation: Hide the month-close pill and floor warning until the season starts; replace with a countdown + what counts.

issues.observation: Result shows '74 · beat your number by 5.0 · COUNTS ON YOUR CARD · Share the card' — no points figure, no league name, no season status.
issues.expected: '12 pts · The Papago Grind' or 'Pre-season: card only'.
issues.actual: The number the form led with disappears at the moment of confirmation.
issues.recommendation: Carry the band + points + league impact onto the result card and the receipt.

issues.screen: Welcome to the season milestone sheet
issues.observation: A 6.4 posting a 74 received 'You broke 80 / 90 / 100 for the first time' trophies; 'Your first round is on the board' appears twice; a 'Share a link — no account needed / Turn off this link' block with no stated target.
issues.expected: Milestones relative to the golfer's index; one 'first round' line; sharing explains what it shares.
issues.actual: Three hollow trophies, a duplicate, and an unexplained link control.
issues.recommendation: Only award break-N milestones below the player's expected score; dedupe; label the share target.

issues.observation: 'You torched your number by 5.0. Sandbagger alert.' on my first-ever posted round; preview and receipt use '+5.0' for beating my number (in golf '+' means over).
issues.expected: Neutral or celebratory copy; a sign convention that matches golf ('−5.0 vs index' or 'beat by 5.0').
issues.actual: A joke that reads as an accusation to a competitive golfer, and an inverted sign.
issues.recommendation: Drop 'Sandbagger alert'; use 'beat your number by 5.0' everywhere, not '+5.0'.

issues.observation: Copy 'No league yet? The round still counts on your card — points apply in any league you join.' shown to a user who is in a league; RATING/SLOPE placeholders (72.1/128) look like values.
issues.expected: League-aware copy; placeholders visibly empty or labeled 'e.g.'.
issues.actual: Stale copy; a hurried user could post with no rating/slope.
issues.recommendation: Swap copy on league membership; prefix placeholders with 'e.g.' and block post without rating/slope.

issues.observation: 'Squads · LIVE NOW — CAPTAINS READY · View' opens 'FORM SQUADS · BLIND DRAW' with both squads Empty, while Standings says 'SQUADS ARE FORMING'.
issues.expected: Status that matches reality ('Not drawn yet — the Pro draws at lock').
issues.actual: False status; there are no captains in a blind draw.
issues.recommendation: Derive the card status from squad state.

issues.observation: The blind-draw formation screen is reachable by a member; every player chip and squad box is a button with no explanation of what tapping does.
issues.expected: Members see a read-only preview or nothing until drawn.
issues.actual: Organizer surface exposed; I did not dare tap a chip.
issues.recommendation: Role-gate or make read-only for members.

issues.screen: Live round setup → match play line
issues.observation: 'Strokes off the low man (Priya): Casey gets 9 — the 9 hardest holes.' with no course-handicap math and no tap; before picking a tee it said 8 with 'estimated card — no real stroke index'.
issues.expected: 'Casey 16 CH − Priya 7 CH = 9' visible or tappable, and a note on allowance.
issues.actual: A number I had to verify by hand.
issues.recommendation: Show course handicaps and the allowance used on the setup line.

issues.screen: Live round → Finish the round dialog / settlement sheet
issues.observation: Buttons 'Finish — no complete member card to post' vs 'This one was casual — post nothing' are not distinguished; result sheet says 'Round posted · 0 CARDS TO THE SEASON · Priya NOT POSTED · INCOMPLETE CARD' while the match settled; the screen behind reverted to the fully-populated 'Set up the round' with a live 'Tee off →'.
issues.expected: Buttons that say what each keeps (match result yes/no); a result header that says 'Match settled · no cards posted'; a clean post-round state.
issues.actual: Three contradictory signals and a screen that looks like the round never happened.
issues.recommendation: Rename the buttons ('Settle the match, skip the cards' / 'Discard everything'); retitle the sheet; return to the ⊕ door after finishing.

issues.screen: Pot tab 'The other stakes' vs live-round settlement
issues.observation: The $5 match settlement ('CASEY PAYS PRIYA $5 · SETTLE UP') appears on the board but the Pot tab's 'other stakes · pride, on the books' still says 'No stakes on the books'; side money is 'settled between you' with no ledger.
issues.expected: A running side-game ledger (who owes whom) somewhere, or a clear statement that side money isn't tracked.
issues.actual: Two different 'books' and the $5 I'm owed lives in neither.
issues.recommendation: Add a side-game settlement ledger to the Pot tab or state explicitly that side stakes are not tracked.

issues.observation: Jordan (no index) is offered as '18.0' ('Leave index blank for an estimated 18') into a $5 net game; 'pick one' game means no skins+match or Nassau/press.
issues.expected: A warning that a player has no index before money is set; multiple concurrent games or at least Nassau.
issues.actual: Fairness footnote; format limits vs how groups actually play.
issues.recommendation: Flag estimated indexes on the setup line when a stake > $0; allow stacking games or add Nassau.

issues.screen: Members & invites 'Share the invite link'; League 'Share the season · Link'
issues.observation: Both buttons produced no visible change (no toast, no link, no sheet) in the browser; Casey's text contained only a bare code.
issues.expected: A copied-link confirmation or a visible URL fallback.
issues.actual: Nothing observable.
issues.recommendation: Always show the URL + 'Copied' fallback when the native share sheet is unavailable.

issues.observation: 'All three run in parallel with the squad race — bylaws §4' — no §4 (or any numbered bylaws document) exists in the app; the bylaws table is collapsed under '▶ LEAGUE RULES & PRO SHOP'.
issues.expected: A tappable bylaws document with sections, expanded by default on the League tab.
issues.actual: Dead reference; rules hidden under a header that also advertises paid features.
issues.recommendation: Expand the bylaws by default and separate them from the Pro Shop; remove or link '§4'.

issues.observation: '$90 Cup champs · $38 Runner-up · $23 Points king' — 'champs' plural with no statement of how a squad's share splits per player; $38+$23 rounding makes $151 of $150; buy-in checkboxes with no owner stated.
issues.expected: Per-player payout preview and exact cents; who ticks a buy-in.
issues.actual: Ambiguous money screen.
issues.recommendation: Show 'per player' amounts, use exact figures, label who marks buy-ins.

issues.observation: 'Squad', 'the Pro', 'pot sheet', 'your number', 'bylaws' introduced without definition; the welcome sheet is titled THREE THINGS TO KNOW and lists four.
issues.expected: First-use definitions (or a glossary link).
issues.actual: Jargon assumed.
issues.recommendation: Define 'squad' and 'the Pro' in the welcome sheet; fix the count.

issues.observation: No head-to-head record after beating Casey 2 UP; no 'you need N more rounds this month'; no 'X points behind Sam'; Home's only forward cue is 'NEXT · Open · PLAN A ROUND'.
issues.expected: A 'why your next round matters' line and a rival/head-to-head strip.
issues.actual: No rivalry surface at all.
issues.recommendation: Add per-player 'next round' guidance (floor status, points to next rank) and a head-to-head record from live matches.

issues.observation: Tagline 'Rally your crew. Post real rounds. Take the cup.' + two buttons; no how-it-works, no example standings, only Terms/Privacy links.
issues.expected: One screen that says what a season, league, and cup are before asking for an email.
issues.actual: Cannot learn the game without signing up.
issues.recommendation: Add a signed-out 'How it works' link/card.

issues.observation: With ?join=THEPTCQ5 the email box appears below the still-visible 'Continue with email' and 'I have an invite code' buttons.
issues.expected: One path: 'You're invited to The Papago Grind — enter your email'.
issues.actual: Two email entry points; I hesitated over which preserved the invite.
issues.recommendation: Hide the generic buttons when an invite is present.

issues.screen: Post a round / round card / You › recent rounds
issues.observation: No edit or delete affordance for a posted round anywhere I looked.
issues.expected: A way to correct a fat-fingered score.
issues.actual: Rounds appear immutable with no explanation.
issues.recommendation: Offer 'Wrong score? Delete and re-post' on the round card with the immutability policy stated.

issues.observation: 'Cups & events · 1 · Played in' before any round or season; undefined 'FORM' badge after two rounds; two stacked buttons 'Post your first round' / 'Post a round'.
issues.expected: Accurate counters and one CTA.
issues.actual: Inflated/undefined stats.
issues.recommendation: Count only started seasons; define FORM; dedupe CTAs.

issues.observation: The Schedule tab navigates away from the Clubhouse to a full-screen calendar with '← HOME'.
issues.expected: Stay within the Clubhouse tab set.
issues.actual: Tab acts as a page jump.
issues.recommendation: Render the calendar inside the Clubhouse or label it as a page.

issues.observation: Console: three more 'Failed to load resource: 502' on Tee off plus an earlier '[live-resume] server query failed: Could not embed because more than one relationship was found for live_rounds and live_round_players'.
issues.expected: Clean console.
issues.actual: Silent backend errors; nothing visibly broke.
issues.recommendation: Fix the ambiguous embed and the 502 source; surface errors that affect the user.

issues.observation: First feed item was 'Match play: Casey def. Marco 1 UP THRU 3 · $5 on the line' — 'Marco' is nobody in the league; the names Casey texted (Marcus Bell) never appear.
issues.expected: Guest results labeled as guests.
issues.actual: Unknown name in the league feed.
issues.recommendation: Tag guests ('Marco · guest') in board items.

issues.observation: 'Short months are waived' and 'Miss it once and your season bye covers you' — 'short month' undefined; whether September (season starts the 5th) is short is unknowable.
issues.expected: Define 'short month' with the actual months it applies to this season.
issues.actual: Undefined term on a rule that costs −5 squad points.
issues.recommendation: List which months of this season carry a floor.
